title: Trace formula for billiard flow on surfaces with concave boundary
summary: We study grazing closed trajectories of the billiard flow $\varphi^t$ on a compact surface $(Σ,g)$ with concave boundary. Under a non-degeneracy condition, which is satisfied for example when $(Σ,g)$ has negative sectional curvature, we compute the trace of a regularized pullback $E_ε(\varphi^t)^* E_ε$ near a closed trajectory grazing once, which is an analogue of the Atiyah--Bott--Guillemin trace formula for closed billiard trajectories.
